reason: The README documents a DSH Web GUI plugin for adding, removing, storing, and searching session tags, primarily enhancing session navigation and organization.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 会话添加、删除、保存标签，并支持按标签搜索和打开会话。
summaries.en: Adds, removes, stores, and searches DSH Web GUI session tags to help organize and navigate conversations.

capabilities: Adds and removes tags on sessions
Persists session tags in a local JSON file
Searches sessions by tag and opens matching sessions
Provides host-side endpoints for reading and setting session tags
